He often sings while he flies — very badly! … Ingrid: In the afternoon he sometimes visits the ships in the port. … Ingrid: He never flies at night. Night is for sleeping in his nest. … Ingrid: And on Sundays? On Sundays Kili does absolutely nothing. It's his favourite habit!
